verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets built-in agentic workflows: a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent. These auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans, so alert-triage work is delegated to in-product AI. Agent configurations are standardized and not customizable on the Starter Plan. These are fixed workflow agents rather than an assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to, and the evidence is marketing pages only. Missing for 10: an interactive or conversational assistant for ad-hoc task delegation, user-directed task assignment and control, in-depth product docs on agent behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
